$comment: Serena Icons concept mapping. All name/extension keys are lowercase (VS Code lowercases both sides). 'x/y' keys use VS Code's single-parent-folder syntax. See spec.md. v5: config/manifest/lock/data keys split out of source, manifest and lock concepts.

strategy.yaml: languageIds only (yaml, home-assistant; 'ansible' moved to the ansible concept in v4). Do NOT add fileExtensions yml/yaml: an extension match (specificity 4) would beat languageIds like the built-in 'dockercompose' (3).
strategy.markdown: languageIds 'markdown' (+ ext mdx/rst, v4: adoc/asciidoc/org/qmd). Do NOT add fileExtensions md: it would beat the built-in chatagent/instructions/prompt/skill languages.
strategy.json: fileExtensions json (deterministic); special JSON files are fileNames and always win.
strategy.lightBlock: The 'light' section must mirror EVERY key of the base section (file, folder*, rootFolder*, fileExtensions, fileNames, languageIds) with *_light icon ids; see spec.md section 5.
strategy.highContrast: omit (applies to hc-black AND hc-light alike; base dark icons stay correct for hc-black).
strategy.v4Reassignment: New brand/language concepts TAKE the keys listed in 'reassigned' from the pre-v4 bucket concept (all spellings kept; nothing unmapped). The logo edition can only show e.g. a Tailwind logo if tailwind.config.* has its own concept. Rebuild with --strict to undo.
strategy.brand: 'brand' = simple-icons v16 slug for the logo edition (src/icons/logos); null = no usable mark (Microsoft/AWS marks are absent from simple-icons, or the concept is generic). The MINIMAL edition never draws the logo.
strategy.v5ConfigSplit: style.md §6: a config file is never a chip; a config file is never a package box or lockfile box; a lockfile always gets the lockfile box. v5 moves such keys into new '<owner>-config' (sliders), '<owner>-lock' (box + lock mark), '<owner>-package' (box) or data (letter + lines) concepts, each with variantOf/splitFrom = the old owner. Same-colour sliders use distinct knob layouts; same-colour boxes/lockboxes use distinct interior details. In the logo edition, new concepts whose old owner had a logo reuse that logo (src/icons/logos/v5-configs.mjs), so those files look the same there.

sharedPrimitives.MANIFEST: package box (nuget, maven, node-package, go-mod, python-project, packages folder; v4: cargo, composer, gemfile, swift-package, pubspec, cocoapods, helm); v5: haskell-package, lua-package, perl-package, zig-package
sharedPrimitives.LOCK: padlock (node-lock, go-sum, python-lock, lock; v4: cargo-lock, composer-lock, gemfile-lock, pubspec-lock, yarn, pnpm, bun); v5: deno-lock, swift-lock, cocoapods-lock, nuget-lock, gradle-lock, bazel-lock, elixir-lock, haskell-lock, nix-lock, r-lock, terraform-lock, proto-lock, c-lock, helm-lock
sharedPrimitives.CONFIG: sliders (dotnet-config, java-config, node-config, tsconfig, js-config, style-config, go-config, python-config, config, config folder; v4: rust-config, c-config, php-config, ruby-config, flutter, nuxt, angular, nest, tailwind, deno, nginx, apache); v5: svelte-config, astro-config, vue-config, yarn-config, pnpm-config, bun-config, swift-config, godot-config, arduino-config, bazel-config, bicep-config, cmake-config, haskell-config, lua-config, nix-config, perl-config, powershell-config, r-config, scala-config, sql-config, terraform-config, graphql-config, proto-config, nuget-config, maven-config, helm-config
sharedPrimitives.TEST: flask or check badge (javascript-test, typescript-test, python-test, test-config, test folder; v4: jest, vitest, playwright, gherkin)
sharedPrimitives.CI_PIPELINE: v4: the ci pipeline glyph recoloured for gitlab, azure-pipelines, jenkins, circleci, bitbucket (+ one distinguishing detail each)
sharedPrimitives.ROLE_CHIP: v4: chip with a 3-letter role monogram (angular-component CMP, angular-directive DIR, typescript-service SVC, typescript-controller CTL, typescript-guard GRD)
